scope: Hypothetical periodic-error diagnostic for public deep fixtures; no HE/error-bound claim.
error_model: Exactly periodic real additive errors independently injected at each planned refresh output; excludes ordinary CKKS error and does not bound actual refresh noise. Ideal public metadata is retained for schedule selection but is not asserted as a bound on noisy intermediates. Polynomial domain checks and original fixture gates remain active.
